description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the loss ratio (in percentage) and the number of TeraFLOPs (TFLOPs) for four different configurations of the SepLLM model, with the loss ratio on the y-axis ranging from 94% to 100% and the TFLOPs on the x-axis spanning from 1e7 to 9e8 on a logarithmic scale. The plot includes four distinct lines: a purple line with triangle markers representing SepLLM (n=64), an orange line with circle markers for SepLLM (n=128), a green line with diamond markers for SepLLM (n=64, H), and a red line with square markers for SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The purple line remains relatively stable around 100% across all TFLOP values. The orange line starts at approximately 98.2% and increases to around 100% as TFLOPs increase, showing a slight peak near 4e8 TFLOPs. The green line begins at about 97.5% and rises to nearly 100%, peaking slightly above 100% near 5e8 TFLOPs before slightly declining. The red line starts at 94% and sharply increases to about 99% before leveling off and slightly decreasing to around 98.5% at the highest TFLOP values.
